intro_text: In the spirit of transparency and accountability, we publish annual post-trip reports detailing screening metrics, financial distributions, and project evaluations.

reports.description: Recce report detailing groundwork, hospital stakeholder visits, and pharmacy assessments in Phnom Penh and surrounding areas.
Comprehensive documentation of mass health clinics in Poipet, screening 1,068 villagers and completing 284 clinical referrals.
Detailed evaluation of village health screenings, dental education, and scholarship distribution.
Summary of post-pandemic trip resumption, partner institution meetings, and initial referral pathway setups.
